nodes.label: ADR 0017: Per-Country Stripe Connect Accounts
nodes.rationale: Introduce org_country_stripe_accounts table (organization_id, country_code, stripe_account_id, currency, charges_enabled, payouts_enabled, details_submitted, status). Resolution at charge time: appointment.branch_id → hierarchy_nodes.country_node_id → country name → ISO code → getConnectAccountForOrgCountry. Falls back to legacy organizations.stripe_connect_account_id. OAuth state encodes countryCode as 4-part HMAC payload. UI: multi-country list at /billing/connect. Legacy column preserved for 1-release deprecation.
alternatives_rejected: One global Stripe acct + auto-FX (~2% FX fee, country restrictions)
Per-branch acct (too granular; branches in same country share legal entity)
Defer to product market expansion (schema cost small now, migration later expensive)
